comment: Held-out test set of the tag probe (ai_tags): photos of the five real days never used to tune (150 evenly spaced and the 108 of the former tags-holdout.json, 31 of them in both) and 75 generated or drawn images from Wikimedia Commons (ai-dev tags-test/generated/manifest.json: title, page, license, author). Judged exhaustively on 2026-11-13 by Claude subagents on 512 px copies, before any tag of the head was seen: yes = present, doubt = borderline (neither right nor wrong), every other word absent; no = judged absent explicitly (former held-out verdicts, or --recheck). The former held-out verdicts were kept: present ones added to yes, absent ones contradicting a yes moved to doubt. Never used to tune.
